declaredOptions.label: Script encoding
declaredOptions.description: Character set the script is read as. The engine guesses, and guesses wrong on some releases; set this when the text comes out as mojibake (--enc:, src/onsyuri/onscripter_main.cpp:383-392).

declaredOptions.label: Font file
declaredOptions.description: Font the engine draws text with (--font, src/onsyuri/onscripter_main.cpp:365-369). Left alone, the game's own default.ttf is used, and a Japanese system font when the game ships none.

declaredOptions.label: Stretch to fill the screen
declaredOptions.description: Stretches the game to the whole display instead of keeping its own aspect ratio (--fullscreen2 rather than --fullscreen, src/onsyuri/onscripter_main.cpp:408-413).

declaredOptions.label: Render width
declaredOptions.description: Forces the width the engine renders at, for a game whose own resolution reads badly on this screen (--width, src/onsyuri/onscripter_main.cpp:398).

declaredOptions.label: Render height
declaredOptions.description: Forces the height the engine renders at (--height, src/onsyuri/onscripter_main.cpp:403).

declaredOptions.label: Sharpness
declaredOptions.description: GLES sharpening applied while scaling the picture up, for example 3.1 (--sharpness, src/onsyuri/onscripter_main.cpp:414).

declaredOptions.label: Skip videos
declaredOptions.description: Skips the game's video scenes instead of handing them to a video player (--no-video, src/onsyuri/onscripter_main.cpp:419).

declaredOptions.label: Turn vertical sync off
declaredOptions.description: Stops waiting for the display refresh (--no-vsync, src/onsyuri/onscripter_main.cpp:422).

declaredOptions.label: Do not rescale archived images
declaredOptions.description: Leaves images in the game's .nsa and .sar archives at their stored size (--disable-rescale, src/onsyuri/onscripter_main.cpp:451).

declaredOptions.label: Outline the text
declaredOptions.description: Draws an outline around text instead of a drop shadow, which reads better over bright art (--render-font-outline, src/onsyuri/onscripter_main.cpp:454).

declaredOptions.label: Advance on wheel down
declaredOptions.description: Lets the wheel-down input advance the text, which on a pad is the right-hand cursor action (--enable-wheeldown-advance, src/onsyuri/onscripter_main.cpp:448).

declaredOptions.label: Ignore the game's key restrictions
declaredOptions.description: Ignores a game's useescspc and getenter commands, so Escape and Space keep their usual meanings (--force-button-shortcut, src/onsyuri/onscripter_main.cpp:445).

declaredOptions.label: Registry file
declaredOptions.description: A file standing in for the Windows registry entries a game reads (--registry, src/onsyuri/onscripter_main.cpp:435).

declaredOptions.label: DLL configuration file
declaredOptions.description: A file standing in for the plugin DLL settings a game reads (--dll, src/onsyuri/onscripter_main.cpp:440).

declaredOptions.label: Key table executable
declaredOptions.description: A game's own .exe, read for the key table it uses to decode an encrypted nscript.dat (--key-exe, src/onsyuri/onscripter_main.cpp:460).

declaredOptions.label: Cache the font
declaredOptions.description: Keeps the default font in memory, which starts scenes faster and costs memory (--fontcache, src/onsyuri/onscripter_main.cpp:465).

declaredOptions.label: Verbose engine log
declaredOptions.description: Prints the engine's own debug output to logcat, for reporting a game that misbehaves (--debug:1, src/onsyuri/onscripter_main.cpp:380).
